scenario_enrichment.summary: Added source-safe scenario distinguishing Design-Build by Administration from Design-Build with Guaranteed Maximum Project Construction Cost.
scenario_enrichment.scenario_excerpt: A client wants the architect to implement the architect's own design because speed, quality, and cost control are all critical. Under SPP 207, the first fork is whether the engagement is Design-Build Services by Administration or Design-Build Services with Guaranteed Maximum Project Construction Cost. The guaranteed-maximum model adds the cost guarantee, shared savings, and limited overrun consequence described in the source. In either model, the architect's professional responsibility and civil liability cover both design and construction of the project, and the architect must keep a separate professional identity while disclosing business interests that could create a conflict of interest.
